body:
> On Shopify, it's really only about jQuery, and maybe lodash in some themes.

As for this immediate need, we do not use jQuery in instantsearch.js so you are good to go (neither algoliasearch.jquery, nor autocomplete.jquery).

> Moreover, it will really be needed as soon as we'll have people building widgets,

Yes this is an issue, we do not have any proposal right now to allow people building their own widget and reusing our react/hogan/lodash.

We could do this:
- expose instantsearch.react/lodash/hogan => allow people building widgets reusing our dependencies
- declare react/lodash/hogan/algoliasearch/algoliasearch-helper as externals in a new build named instantsearch.without.deps[.min].js
  - this would mean that the user would have to include react/lodash/hogan/algoliasearch/.. in his own webpage

What do you think?
